## EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Objective:** Transform HTML prototype into production-ready monorepo application for observing & tracking real application of architect role in business-critical initiatives.

**Stack:**
- **Frontend:** React 18+ TypeScript, Tailwind CSS (or exact CSS from prototype)
- **Backend:** NestJS 10+ TypeScript
- **Database:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- **Deployment:** Render (Docker)
- **Testing:** Playwright (E2E), Jest (unit)

**Core Features:**
- Home Dashboard: metrics, radar charts, bar charts, roster table with filters
- 3-Phase Form: Preparar (value/barriers/motivators) → Gemba Baseline (behaviors/flow) → Diagnóstico (debrief/gaps/conditions/CSAT)
- Import/Export: JSON backup
- Responsive design: desktop → mobile
- Multi-tenancy: Supabase Auth + RLS

---

## GRAY AREAS & AMBIGUITIES RESOLVED

| Issue | Decision | Rationale |
|-------|----------|-----------|
| **Multi-user sync** | Supabase real-time (optional future phase); currently RLS + polling | Simple multi-tenant per user; no concurrent edit conflicts if each user owns records |
| **Data versioning on import** | No versioning; import replaces (but users backup first) | Simpler UX; emphasize export-before-import workflow |
| **Duplicate architect names** | UNIQUE(user_id, architect_name) in DB | Prevents accidents within a user; allows re-use across users |
| **Offline support** | Draft in localStorage, sync on reconnect | PWA-ready architecture; Supabase enables seamless sync |
| **Evidence attachments** | Text-based only; no file uploads in MVP | Keeps MVP focused; evidence captured as text, links, descriptions |
| **Radar chart library** | Native SVG (preserve from HTML prototype) | No dependencies; already implemented; works light/dark |
| **Responsive breakpoints** | Tailwind: `md:(950px)`, `sm:(620px)` | Match HTML `@media` queries exactly |
| **Print/PDF support** | CSS `@media print` + browser native print-to-PDF | No external PDF library; uses standard browser Print dialog |
| **Missing behaviors/flow data on Phase 2 access** | Warn or disable tab access; show inline error | Enforce data quality; prevent incomplete diagnoses |
| **Computed "complete" flag** | `is_complete = bool(≥1 behavior) && bool(≥1 gap) && bool(≥1 flow objective/out)` | Simple heuristic; can refine if needed |
| **User roles & permissions** | MVP: each user is owner of own records; no sharing/collaboration | Monorepo handles multi-tenancy per user; can add org/role layer later |

## FEATURE SPECIFICATION

### 1. OVERVIEW

**Purpose:** Research & tracking platform for observing real application of architect role in organizations. Captures gap analysis, moving motivators, workflow observation, and satisfaction metrics per architect per cycle.

**Core Entities:**
- **Record** (per architect-cycle): metadata, prep data, baseline observations, diagnosis findings
- **Behaviors** (8 fixed items): observed states + evidence/artifacts
- **Moving Motivators** (10 fixed items): ordered list with impact rating
- **Flow Steps** (variable): real process reconstruction from initiative to decision
- **Gaps** (variable): classified findings with evidence & condition for exercising role
- **Conditions** (7 fixed items): role-enabling prerequisites & their status

#### 2.3 Data Model (Supabase / PostgreSQL Schema)

```sql
-- Supabase Auth: Leverages built-in auth.users table

-- Table: gemba_records
CREATE TABLE public.gemba_records (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) NOT NULL,
  
  -- Metadata
  architect_name VARCHAR(255),
  macrodomain VARCHAR(255),
  initiative_name VARCHAR(255),
  business_referent VARCHAR(255),
  
  -- Phase 0: Preparar
  prep_value TEXT,
  prep_barrier TEXT,
  
  -- Phase 1: Gemba Baseline
  behaviors JSONB, -- [{state: 'si|par|no|na', fact: '', artifact: ''}, ...]
  flow_steps JSONB, -- [{step: '', objective: '', with: '', out: '', waste: ''}, ...]
  
  -- Phase 2: Diagnosis
  debrief_strength TEXT,
  debrief_selfgap TEXT,
  debrief_block TEXT,
  debrief_try TEXT,
  flow_qa JSONB, -- [q1_answer, q2_answer, q3_answer, q4_answer]
  gaps JSONB, -- [{text: '', type: '', evidence: '', condition: ''}, ...]
  conditions JSONB, -- [{name: '', status: 'si|par|no', evidence: ''}, ...]
  csat_score INT CHECK (csat_score IS NULL OR (csat_score >= 1 AND csat_score <= 5)),
  csat_comment TEXT,
  
  -- Computed fields
  is_complete BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'draft', -- 'draft', 'in_progress', 'complete'
  
  UNIQUE(user_id, architect_name),
  CONSTRAINT valid_macro_name CHECK (macrodomain IS NULL OR macrodomain != '')
);

-- Table: gemba_moving_motivators
CREATE TABLE public.gemba_moving_motivators (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  record_id UUID REFERENCES gemba_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  "order" INT NOT NULL,
  impact INT DEFAULT 0 CHECK (impact >= -2 AND impact <= 2),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(record_id, name)
);

-- Table: gemba_settings
CREATE TABLE public.gemba_settings (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  target_scope INT DEFAULT 5 CHECK (target_scope >= 1 AND target_scope <= 500),
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

-- Enable Row-Level Security
ALTER TABLE gemba_records ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE gemba_moving_motivators ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE gemba_settings ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- RLS Policies: Users see/edit only their own records
CREATE POLICY "Users see own records"
  ON gemba_records FOR SELECT
  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users insert own records"
  ON gemba_records FOR INSERT
  WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users update own records"
  ON gemba_records FOR UPDATE
  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

CREATE POLICY "Users delete own records"
  ON gemba_records FOR DELETE
  USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Similar policies for motivators and settings
```

#### 2.4 Frontend API Contract (NestJS Backend)

```
GET /api/records
  Query: ?macrodomain=X&status=Y&limit=50&offset=0
  Response: 200 { records: [...], total: N, hasMore: bool }
  Auth: Required

POST /api/records
  Body: { 
    architectName, macrodomain, initiativeName, businessReferent,
    prepValue, prepBarrier,
    behaviors, flowSteps,
    debrieefStrength, debrieefSelfgap, debrieefBlock, debrieefTry,
    flowQA, gaps, conditions,
    csatScore, csatComment
  }
  Response: 201 { id, createdAt }
  Auth: Required

PATCH /api/records/:id
  Body: { field: value, ... } (partial update)
  Response: 200 { id, updatedAt }
  Auth: Required (owner only)

DELETE /api/records/:id
  Response: 200 { deleted: true }
  Auth: Required (owner only)

GET /api/records/:id/export
  Response: 200 { JSON file, Content-Type: application/json }
  Auth: Required (owner only)

POST /api/import
  Body: FormData { file: JSON }
  Response: 200 { imported: N, errors: [...] }
  Auth: Required

GET /api/dashboard/metrics
  Query: ?macrodomain=X
  Response: 200 { 
    totalArchitects, completeRecords, totalGaps, csatAverage,
    gapsByType: { 'Conocimiento': 5, ... }
  }
  Auth: Required

GET /api/dashboard/radars
  Query: ?macrodomain=X
  Response: 200 {
    gapValues: [0.5, 0.3, ...], // 8 values per behavior
    motivatorValues: [0.6, 0.4, ...] // 10 values per motivator
  }
  Auth: Required
```

#### 3.2 Key Computed Values (Backend Service Logic)

**Dashboard Service:**
```typescript
getMetrics(userId: string, macrodomain?: string) {
  const records = filtered by user + optional macrodomain;
  
  totalArchitects = count(records);
  completeRecords = count(records where is_complete = true);
  totalGaps = sum(count(gaps) per record);
  csatAverage = avg(csat_score) of records where csat_score IS NOT NULL;
  gapsByType = {
    'Conocimiento': count(gaps where type = 'Conocimiento'),
    ...
  };
  
  return { totalArchitects, completeRecords, totalGaps, csatAverage, gapsByType };
}

getRadars(userId: string, macrodomain?: string) {
  const records = filtered by user + optional macrodomain;
  
  gapValues = []; // 8 values for 8 behaviors
  for each behavior:
    states = collect(state from behavior observation in all records);
    inverted = map(state => state === 'na' ? 0 : state === 'si' ? 0 : state === 'par' ? 0.5 : 1);
    gapValues[i] = avg(inverted);
  
  motivatorValues = []; // 10 values for 10 motivators
  for each motivator:
    orders = collect(order from motivator in all records);
    normalized = map(order => (order + 1) / 10);
    motivatorValues[i] = avg(normalized);
  
  return { gapValues, motivatorValues };
}

isRecordComplete(record: GembaRecord): boolean {
  return (
    record.behaviors.some(b => b.state !== 'na') &&
    record.gaps.some(g => g.text.trim().length > 0) &&
    record.flowSteps.some(f => f.objective.trim().length > 0 || f.out.trim().length > 0)
  );
}
```

**Records Service:**
```typescript
// Auto-compute is_complete before saving
beforeSave(record) {
  record.is_complete = this.isRecordComplete(record);
  record.status = record.is_complete ? 'complete' : record.debrief.strength ? 'in_progress' : 'draft';
  record.updated_at = NOW();
}

// Enforce UNIQUE(user_id, architect_name)
createRecord(userId, architectName, ...): Record {
  existing = db.query('SELECT * FROM gemba_records WHERE user_id = ? AND architect_name = ?');
  if (existing) throw ConflictException('Architect already exists');
  ...
}
```

**Breakpoints:**
- Desktop (≥950px): 4-column metrics, 2-column charts, 2-column grid
- Tablet (620px—950px): 2-column metrics, 1-column charts, 2-column grid
- Mobile (<620px): 1-column everything, full-width buttons

**Responsive Rules:**
- Metrics: `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)` → `repeat(2, 1fr)` → `1fr`
- Charts: `grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr` → `1fr`
- Form metadata: `grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr)` → `repeat(2, 1fr)` → `1fr`
- Flow table: Show all 7 columns on desktop; collapse on mobile (hide headers, show essentials)

---

### 5. KEY ASSUMPTIONS MADE

1. **Single user per login** (not org/team-based MVP)
2. **No real-time sync** in MVP (refresh page to see updates)
3. **No file attachments** for evidence (text-based only)
4. **No versioning** (import overwrites current; users export before import)
5. **SVG charts only** (no Chart.js, D3, or Recharts)
6. **Print-to-PDF via browser** (no backend PDF generation)
7. **8 behaviors, 10 motivators, 10 gap types, 7 conditions are fixed** (not configurable)
8. **Moving motivators stored in separate table** (for reorder/impact persistence)

## IMPLEMENTATION PLAN

### Phase 1: Infrastructure & Auth (2–3 days)

**Tasks:**
1. Set up Supabase project + PostgreSQL (create all tables + RLS policies)
2. Configure Supabase Auth (email/password signup & login)
3. Create NestJS backend shell (main.ts, app.module, database connection)
4. Implement SupabaseAuthGuard (verify JWT, inject user)
5. Create basic health check endpoint (GET /health)
6. Set up Docker Compose for local dev (backend + Supabase locally)
7. Test auth flow manually (register, login, verify token)

**Deliverables:**
- Supabase project live with schema
- NestJS backend compiles & runs locally
- Auth guard working (protected endpoints reject unauthenticated)
- Health check endpoint responds 200
- Docker Compose file for local development

**Definition of Done:**
- `POST /auth/signup` registers user
- `POST /auth/login` returns JWT
- `GET /api/records` with invalid JWT → 401
- `GET /health` → 200 OK

## ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

### Functional Requirements
- [ ] ✅ All 8 behaviors observable with state radio + 2 evidence textareas
- [ ] ✅ 10 moving motivators draggable + impact slider (-2 to +2)
- [ ] ✅ Flow reconstruction: variable steps, add/delete, waste classification
- [ ] ✅ 7 conditions checkable as: enabled/partial/barrier + evidence
- [ ] ✅ Gaps: text + type (10 options) + evidence + condition
- [ ] ✅ CSAT: 5-point scale + comment
- [ ] ✅ Home metrics: Total, complete, gaps count, CSAT avg
- [ ] ✅ Radar chart 1: Gaps distribution (inverted)
- [ ] ✅ Radar chart 2: Motivators average importance
- [ ] ✅ Bar chart: Gaps by classification type
- [ ] ✅ Roster table: Filterable by macrodomain + status
- [ ] ✅ Export: JSON backup of full record
- [ ] ✅ Import: Load JSON backup with validation
- [ ] ✅ Auto-save: All inputs debounced to DB
- [ ] ✅ Record completion logic: Marks as "complete" when criteria met
- [ ] ✅ Multi-tenancy: RLS enforces per-user data isolation

### Non-Functional Requirements
- [ ] ✅ Responsive: All devices (desktop, tablet, mobile)
- [ ] ✅ Responsive breakpoints: 1280px, 950px, 620px, 375px
- [ ] ✅ Design parity: 100% visual match to HTML prototype
- [ ] ✅ Dockerized: `docker-compose up` runs locally
- [ ] ✅ Render-compatible: Deployed to Render with HTTPS
- [ ] ✅ Print/PDF: CSS @media print hides nav, all content visible
- [ ] ✅ Accessibility: WCAG AA (Lighthouse ≥90)
- [ ] ✅ Performance: Page load <2s, charts render <500ms
- [ ] ✅ Security: Supabase Auth + RLS, no XSS/SQL injection vulnerabilities

### Browser/Playwright Testing
- [ ] ✅ Playwright: All E2E test suites passing (Phase 1–9)
- [ ] ✅ Playwright: Visual regression tests passing (design parity)
- [ ] ✅ Jest: Unit tests for services (calculations, validations)
- [ ] ✅ Jest: Integration tests for API endpoints
